items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I played with Boz and Scagliona.

ctx.x: Bill Bourgeois, that's right. He told me how he always missed getting recorded. He would always come last time. That's right.

Let's see. You say you heard rap once, huh? I heard rap once, that's right. Well, of course, there were a lot of good musicians and a lot of good bands. I think at the Hollywood Dance Hall on St. Claude Avenue, that open air dance hall that Shockey and Leon Primer had. That was a good spot there in those days. Back about 32, 33. Fazzola played there. I played with Boz and Scagliona. Boz and Scagliona used to make a real good team.
What would they play? Did you play both?
